title: Media element "created with a src attribute" trigger duplicates the src attribute trigger
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#concept-media-load-algorithm-at-creation says:

> If a media element is created with a `src` attribute, the user agent must immediately invoke the media element's resource selection algorithm.

...and the next paragraph says:

> If a `src` attribute of a media element is set or changed, the user agent must invoke the media element's media element load algorithm.

Elements are created without attributes: the parser and cloning append attributes after creating the element, and `new Audio(src)` sets `src` after creating it. That append or set already runs the second trigger. So the first one is either never true, or, if read as "created from a token with `src`", it runs the resource selection algorithm a second time next to the one the load algorithm started.

The first paragraph was added in 533d5a3 ([bug 24325](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=24325)) so that new elements with `src` load, which the second trigger covers. Maybe remove it and point the `Audio()` constructor's note, which links to it, at the second trigger. (#13188 removes the analogous `poster` creation trigger.)
